title: Parsed CV
description: Version 1.0. Structured data extracted from one CV, stored in candidates.parsed_data. Every object is closed: a new field needs a new schema version. Rules for changing it: docs/ml/parsed-cv-schema.md.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was written with. A change that keeps older records valid adds its version to this list; a breaking change gets a new schema file.

source.description: Who wrote this version of the record: the CV parser, or a recruiter who corrected it.

headline.description: Current or most recent job title.

summary.description: The candidate's own profile or summary paragraph.

skills.description: Skills found in the CV. May be empty.

confidence.description: Confidence from 0 to 1 per field, keyed by JSON Pointer into this record, e.g. /contact/email or /experiences/0/title. A field with no entry has no confidence value; that is not the same as low confidence.

contact.description: Who the CV belongs to, as read from the CV. Never read by the scorer.

raw.description: The skill as written in the CV.

normalized.description: Canonical name of the skill, or null when it is not recognized.

start.description: First month in the position, as YYYY-MM. null: unknown.

end.description: Last month in the position, as YYYY-MM. null: unknown, or the position is current (see is_current).

is_current.description: True if the candidate still holds the position. Defaults to false.

bullets.description: Achievements or responsibilities, one per entry.

level.description: Level as written in the CV, e.g. B2, native, fluent.
